name: Semorphone
summary: Semorphone (Mr 2264) is an opiate analogue that is an N-substituted derivative of oxymorphone.

pharmacology.text: Semorphone is a partial agonist at μ-opioid receptors.

uses.text: It is not currently used in medicine, and is not a controlled drug, although it might be considered to be a controlled substance analogue of oxymorphone on the grounds of its related chemical structure in some jurisdictions such as the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Partial opioid agonists can cause drowsiness, nausea, dizziness and slowed breathing, can bring on withdrawal in people dependent on other opioids, and can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。部分鴉片促效劑可能引起嗜睡、噁心、頭暈和呼吸減慢，可能使依賴其他鴉片類藥物的人出現戒斷，本身也可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。部分鸦片促效剂可能引起嗜睡、恶心、头晕和呼吸减慢，可能使依赖其他鸦片类药物的人出现戒断，本身也可能导致依赖。

fact.en: Semorphone is oxymorphone with a different group on the nitrogen. Changing that one group is the classic way to turn a full opioid agonist into a partial one.
fact.zh: Semorphone 是把羥嗎啡酮氮原子上的基團換成別的基團。改變這一個基團，是把完全鴉片促效劑變成部分促效劑的經典做法。
fact.zhHans: Semorphone 是把羟吗啡酮氮原子上的基团换成别的基团。改变这一个基团，是把完全鸦片促效剂变成部分促效剂的经典做法。
